title: Form: per-step foot plants
instructions: Mark the frame where each foot touches the floor during the approach, in order: Step 1 (first step) through the slide-foot plant (the last step). Use the MOMENT the foot first contacts the floor. Press X (Not visible) for any step number beyond this bowler's approach (e.g. Step 6 on a 5-step approach) or a plant the camera cannot see. The hints open the player near the detector's current guess — move to the exact contact frame and set it. These per-plant times are the ground truth for the step-count + foot-strike detector (DEC-120 / form baseline).
